front.title: YANG Model for BGP Flow Specification

abstract.t: This document defines a YANG data model for the BGP Flow Specification (Flowspec) address families (RFC8955 and RFC8956). The model augments the BGP YANG model to add the IPv4 Flow Specification (AFI, SAFI = 1, 133) and IPv6 Flow Specification (AFI, SAFI = 2, 133) address families, including Flowspec-specific configuration, the Flow Specification RIB, and per-neighbor Adj-RIBs.
